shown.message:
I approved `paper-repo`#9 at its new head, `78d468d`.

I built that head locally to check, since the `dev` PDF was built from a different commit:
- **Type 3 font:** gone, as `pdffonts` shows. The head carries `\renewcommand{\ttdefault}{pcr}` in `paper/main.tex`.
- **Length:** 25 pages. The main text ends on page 9 and References start on page 10.
- **Checklist and style:** the checklist is inside the PDF, and `paper/neurips_2026.sty` is still byte-identical to the kit.

I did not check the text edits made since my last review (claims, scope and novelty wording, selector wording). They are not venue requirements.

I read nothing in the Outline revision that changes the budget, so I left `VENUE.md` as it is.
